title: Full Pre-Render at Build
description: Renders every page to plain HTML during the build step, so visitors receive finished documents with no server work per request. The result is fast, cacheable everywhere, and survivable: the site keeps serving even if the database and APIs behind it go down.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Incremental Static Regeneration
description: Rebuilds only the pages whose data changed instead of the whole site, then swaps them into the CDN. Large sites stay fast to update - a one-word fix rebuilds one page in seconds rather than regenerating a hundred thousand pages.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Markdown-to-HTML Pipeline
description: Converts author-friendly Markdown files into HTML through a fixed pipeline of parsing, transformation, and templating. Writers edit plain text while the pipeline guarantees consistent markup, escaping, and structure across every page.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Data-Layer Sourcing
description: Pulls content from CMSs, APIs, and files into a unified data layer at build time, so templates query one consistent source. Build-time sourcing means runtime pages never wait on flaky APIs - failures happen during the build, where they can be fixed before deploy.

fields.caveat: build fails loudly on bad data

provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Image Optimization at Build
description: Resizes, compresses, and converts images to modern formats during the build, emitting responsive srcsets automatically. Pages ship images already tuned for each screen size, so phones download small files and desktops get sharp ones with no runtime image server.

fields.caveat: watch build times on huge libraries

provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Sitemap Generation
description: Generates the XML sitemap automatically from the page list at build time, so search engines always see the current URL inventory. Manual sitemaps rot within weeks; generated ones stay correct because they derive from the same source as the pages themselves.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: RSS Feed Generation
description: Builds RSS/Atom feeds from the content collection during the build, giving readers and aggregators a stable subscription endpoint. Because feeds generate from the same data as pages, they never drift out of sync with what the site actually published.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Build-Time Search Index
description: Compiles a compact full-text search index during the build that ships with the site, enabling instant client-side search with no server. The index is versioned with the content it covers, so search results always match the pages actually deployed.

fields.caveat: keep index small; shard if huge

provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Edge-Cached HTML
description: Serves pre-rendered HTML from CDN edge locations close to each visitor, cutting latency to tens of milliseconds worldwide. Since pages are static files, caching is trivially correct - the edge serves bytes until the next deploy replaces them.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Atomic Deploys
description: Publishes each build as one immutable snapshot and flips traffic to it in a single step, so visitors never see a half-updated site. If the new build misbehaves, rollback is just flipping back to the previous snapshot - instant and total.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Preview Builds
description: Builds every pull request into its own temporary URL, letting reviewers click through the actual rendered result before merging. Design and content review happen on the real artifact instead of screenshots, catching layout bugs early.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Content-Hashed Filenames
description: Names built assets with a hash of their contents, so browsers can cache them forever and still always fetch the newest version. When content changes the filename changes, which makes cache invalidation automatic and exact.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: 404 Fallback Pages
description: Ships a designed 404 page as a static file so missing URLs get a helpful branded response instead of a server error. On static hosts the 404 page can even suggest nearby valid pages using the same client-side search index.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: i18n Static Routes
description: Pre-renders one copy of each page per language under locale-prefixed routes like /es/ and /fr/. Every language is a real static page - fast and indexable - instead of a client-side translation layer that flashes untranslated content.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Build Performance Budgets
description: Sets hard limits on build time and output size that fail the build when exceeded, keeping the site fast by construction. Budgets turn performance from a wish into a gate: a page that ships too much JavaScript simply does not deploy.

fields.caveat: tune budgets as the site grows

provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
